#462 · Magnet Area Pokémon

Magnezone

Electric Steel

Sinnoh · Generation 4

Magnezone is an Electric/Steel-type Magnet Area Pokémon first found in Sinnoh (Generation 4). It stands 1.2 m tall and weighs 180 kg. It evolves from Magneton. Its highest base stat is Sp. Atk (130), with a base stat total of 535.
